description: MEMBRA Risk Register - Identified risks and mitigation strategies

risks.name: Real Funds Exposure
risks.description: Risk of accidentally using real SOL or real customer funds instead of Devnet test SOL
mitigation: Devnet guardrails enforced at startup (devnet_guardrails.py)
ALLOW_REAL_FUNDS=false by default in .env.example
assert_no_real_funds() function checks environment variables
Database as source of truth prevents accidental mainnet transactions
LaunchPad requires explicit human approval for mainnet promotion

risks.name: Mainnet Accidental Activation
risks.description: Risk of agents accidentally executing on mainnet instead of Devnet
mitigation: ALLOW_MAINNET=false by default
assert_devnet_only() function enforces Devnet-only mode
Separate environment files for Devnet vs mainnet
LaunchPad controlled promotion path with human approval gates

risks.name: Live Trading Without Compliance
risks.description: Risk of agents engaging in live trading before compliance review
mitigation: ALLOW_LIVE_TRADING=false by default
assert_no_live_trading() function checks environment
Graduation does not equal mainnet access
LaunchPad requires compliance review before mainnet promotion

risks.name: Home Access Privacy
risks.description: Risk of exposing private home information through inventory detection
mitigation: Access mode classification (No Entry, Door Handoff, Meet Halfway)
Privacy risk scoring in membra_index_dictionary.json
Home entry required flag for risk assessment
User-gasless mode reduces need for home entry

risks.name: Credential Exposure
risks.description: Risk of exposing API keys, tokens, or other credentials in code or logs
mitigation: .env.example template without real secrets
Hashed API key storage in database schema
Structured logging that excludes secrets
Security warning in architecture diagram to rotate credentials

risks.name: Household Data Leakage
risks.description: Risk of leaking household inventory data through logs or exports
mitigation: Structured logging with request IDs
No logging of raw inventory data in production
Controlled export functions with user consent
Data retention policies in documentation

risks.name: Insurance Coverage Gaps
risks.description: Risk of insufficient insurance for high-risk inventory items
mitigation: Risk grade classification (Low, Medium, High, Prohibited)
Insurance required flag in risk index
Prohibited flag for uninsurable items
Deposit requirements for medium-risk items

risks.name: Prohibited Categories
risks.description: Risk of listing prohibited or regulated items
mitigation: Regulatory risk scoring in membra_index_dictionary.json
Prohibited flag in risk index
Regulatory risk assessment in graduation checks
Manual review for high-regulatory-risk categories

docs/prohibited-risk-categories.md defines prohibited categories: vehicles, firearms, hazardous materials, medical devices, prescription medications, smart home devices with cameras, food/alcohol storage, entire home access, bedroom/bathroom access

risks.name: Asset Damage or Theft
risks.description: Risk of damage or theft during rental transactions
mitigation: Damage risk and theft risk scoring
Proof requirement for transactions
Return photo verification
Deposit requirements based on risk level
ProofBook for cryptographic evidence

risks.name: Database State Loss
risks.description: Risk of losing canonical database state if Devnet resets
mitigation: Database as source of truth doctrine
ProofBook entries can replay proof anchors
Backup strategy documented in roadmap
Database preservation rules in devnet-doctrine.md

risks.name: Proof Hash Collisions
risks.description: Risk of SHA-256 hash collisions in proof verification
mitigation: SHA-256 is cryptographically secure
Canonical JSON serialization for consistency
ProofBook stores full proof data for verification
Explorer URLs for independent verification

risks.name: App Logic Bugs
risks.description: Risk of bugs in approval flow, liquidity calculations, or exports
mitigation: Unit tests for core functions (test_app_logic.py)
Claim registry maps README claims to code evidence
Verification firewall pass identified and fixed approval bug
Fixed Trust-Adjusted Liquidity calculation to output dollars

risks.name: Fake Traction Claims
risks.description: Risk of claiming real users, revenue, or transactions when only simulation exists
mitigation: README clearly states 'Pre-user. Post-thesis. Artifact-complete.'
All demo data marked as simulation/mock
Settlement ledger labeled 'MOCK SETTLEMENT LEDGER (DEMO/DRY-RUN ONLY)'
Investor summary includes disclaimer about simulation
No claims of live trading without compliance

risks.name: Regulatory Non-Compliance
risks.description: Risk of violating financial or data regulations in target markets
mitigation: Regulatory risk scoring in index dictionary
Compliance review required for mainnet promotion
LaunchPad includes compliance checks
Legal review in roadmap as operational upgrade

risks.name: Intellectual Property Infringement
risks.description: Risk of infringing on existing product IP or branding
mitigation: Original branding, copy, and implementation
No proprietary content from existing platforms
Original data in sample inventory
Clear differentiation from competitors in thesis

disclaimer: This risk register documents identified risks and mitigation strategies. Residual risk assessments are based on current implementation and may change with deployment or regulatory changes.
